description: This file defines the class `ContactsViewCloseContactAddressPopup`, which extends `ViewList` and provides functionality to display a popup window and close it based on a request parameter. It is part of the SuiteCRM project, handling the 'close contact address' popup view.

classes.name: ContactsViewCloseContactAddressPopup
classes.description: A view class handling the display and closing of the 'close contact address' popup in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: CloseContactAddressPopup
methods.description: Constructor method that calls the parent constructor.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Displays the popup, and if 'close_window' is set in the request, executes JavaScript to close the window.
